title: Now Artist, 1991: HIS
notes: TBS (JOKR-TV) late-night music programme, S-VHS off-air; the HIS trio (Hosono, Imawano, Sakamoto) interviewed on a wall of four monitors; a text card explaining the group read aloud, the I / S / HIS letter idents, 'Hosono, now 44' into black into the four faces, a Shinjuku capsule-hotel commercial (4,100 yen a night, sauna, a phone number), ten seconds mid-song of a silhouette singing 500 Miles in smoke, and the sponsor card into 'see you next time'; five of six windows are talk, one is sung; baked distortion 0.5
